clean_source_blocks.text: WASHINGTON - A suspected gunman believed to be from California opened fire outside the Washington Hilton, where the annual dinner of White House correspondents was being held, prompting a massive law enforcement response and the evacuation of President Donald Trump and other attendees.
The man arrested at the event attended by President Trump is due in court on Monday.
